name: The Southwilds
description: A hard, wide country south of the bridge: ruined towns, dry heath and hungry creatures, with Cairnwall at the heart of it.

sw_0_0.description: Barren land under a heavy sky, scattered with the debris of some old war. The wind has teeth.

sw_6_3.name: The Warden's Road
sw_6_3.description: The road squeezes between two walls of tumbled stone. Beyond them, a gate in a great wall stands open on the south. In the middle of the road, as still as a statue, stands something that is not a statue.

south.failure_message: The colossus does not move aside. It will take a very old, very quiet tune to get past it, or a very long fight.

fen_edge.name: The Fen's Edge
fen_edge.description: The ground goes soft and black, and the path ends at a dead tree in a pool of green scum.

fen_deep.name: The Deep Fen
fen_deep.description: Reeds taller than a man close in on every side, and the water is up to your knees.

fen_end.name: A Place in the Fen
fen_end.description: A small hummock of firmer ground in the middle of the reeds, with a flat stone sunk half into it, and nothing at all to say why you should search it.
